description: This file defines a simple implementation of the Placeholder interface used for testing purposes within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides a singleton instance, a fixed prefix, and support for a specific placeholder name.

classes.name: SimplePlaceholder
classes.description: A singleton class implementing the Placeholder interface for String placeholders, used primarily for testing within the project.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for the placeholder, which is 'test'.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns a list containing the supported placeholder name, 'placeholder'.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the given name matches the supported placeholder name, ignoring case.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder by returning the placeholder source if supported, otherwise returns empty.
